transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because I’ve been trying for over a year to get someone to take seriously what’s happening at work. The new ticket rotation and these security audits—I believe they’re being used to create a paper trail against me. Management keeps showing me logs and saying it’s just policy, but I don’t think that’s the whole story.
Have you ever heard voices, whispering, or other sounds when no one was around?
No, I haven’t noticed voices or sounds like that when I’m by myself.
Have you ever felt that your thoughts were being interfered with, or that an outside force was controlling your mind or body?
No, I don’t feel like anything is controlling my mind or my body. My thoughts feel like my own.
Outside of work, do you often find yourself questioning whether you can trust your friends, family, or partners?
I’m not sure what you mean exactly. I haven’t really noticed that being an issue outside of work.
